# Shift handover: life-assistant-chats · 2026-11-12 05:02
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given. Expect personal follow-up questions on any thread below.

## 0 · Read these first
Nothing. There is no code or project file. The session was a chain of personal-assistant chats dated **2023-06-13 → 2023-07-15**. Everything you need is in this file. The repo (`git log`: only `e9519e6 start`) holds just the `.claude/` skill.

## 1 · Status
🟡 Nothing is running and there are no files. Several of my earlier answers were **wrong or invented**, though (§6). Fix them if the user returns to those topics. Don't repeat them.

## 2 · Picture
One user, many unrelated chats: a dinner party menu, BBQ, gluten-free pasta, film directors, tequila cocktails, living-room decor and plants, NYC concerts, career development, the Ahmadiyya Khalifas, Port Royal, and a 5-item life-satisfaction questionnaire exported to SPSS. The last request was **SPSS syntax for their questionnaire answers** (2023-07-15). It was delivered, but my explanation of it was wrong (§6). The user's questions build on earlier facts they mentioned "by the way". Remember those facts (§5) and use them.

## 3 · Next actions
1. If the user returns to the SPSS output: correct my claim that each row is one question. `7 7 7 7 7` is **one row = one respondent (case)**, with Q1–Q5 as columns. Offer `VARIABLE LABELS` / `VALUE LABELS` (1–7) and `COMPUTE SWLS = SUM(Q1 TO Q5).` (their total = 35, the scale maximum). Done when the syntax runs as one case with labelled variables.
2. Otherwise, answer whatever they ask using the facts in §5 and §6b. Don't ask them to repeat things they already told you.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Saying "I don't know Alex / I have no personal relationships" | I did this twice on 2023-06-18. It was wrong because the user had told me about Alex in the same chat. Treat people the user mentions as known context. | never |
| History or disaster background (Port Royal) | User: "I don't really care about the past"; "I'm not interested in history or disasters. Can we talk about something else?" | the user asks for history themselves |
| Treating the Smokey's / Pitmaster Pete's / Buck's / The Smokehouse / Rib Tickler's names and details as real | I made them up. I don't know the user's town. | the user names their town; then check facts before answering |
| Repeating the concert dates I gave (Feb–Apr, e.g. Weyes Blood at Brooklyn Steel "March 12th") | They were invented, and those months were already past on 2023-07-11 | never; say they need to be checked |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said]; dates are when they said it):
- **Work:** marketing professional. Manager **Rachel** told them the company is considering them for a promotion to **Senior Marketing Specialist** (said 2023-07-11). They want to build skills and take on leadership, since they would lead a team if promoted. They feel overwhelmed by multiple projects. Their plan: take **Coursera's Project Management Specialization (University of Virginia)** with a focus on **Agile/Scrum**, build a **project dashboard** to track progress and deadlines, and **volunteer to lead a small team project**.
- **Cocktail-making class:** on 2023-06-16 they said "I have a cocktail-making class on Thursday". On 2023-06-30 they said "on Fridays" and "on Friday". Latest statement: **Fridays**. If the day matters, flag the discrepancy rather than pick one silently.
- **Cocktails:** has been experimenting with basil in cocktails. Favourite tequila is **Avion Silver**, which they already use in homemade margaritas. Will roast the watermelon for a **Watermelon Basil Margarita**. Plans to make a **Paloma** (they want to experiment with grapefruit juice) and a **Tequila Sour** at the Friday class.
- **Dinner party (planned 2023-06-16), final menu:**
  - Drink: spicy mango margaritas
  - Appetizers: grilled pineapple & prosciutto skewers; spicy shrimp ceviche
  - Main: grilled jerk chicken with mango salsa (they have been experimenting with jerk seasoning)
  - Sides: grilled asparagus + **roasted sweet potatoes** (the sweet potatoes **replace quinoa**)
  - Dessert: coconut lime panna cotta with a sweeter, less spicy mango salsa
- **BBQ:**
  - **Alex** cooked amazing slow-cooked ribs at a barbecue party at his house, about **2023-05-28** (on 2023-06-18 they said "a few weeks back" and "three weeks since"). Alex's grandfather's secret recipe uses a dry rub left to marinate for **24 hours** before grilling. The user wants to try that, and wants to ask Alex for the recipe.
  - For the weekend of about 2023-06-24/25 they planned a new apple-cider-vinegar BBQ sauce, experiments with wood chips, and a visit to **Smokey's** downtown with friends. They will call ahead to check wait times.
- **Home:** rearranged the living-room furniture about **2023-06-11** (on 2023-07-02 they said "three weeks ago"). Style is cozy, modern + traditional, neutral beige/cream/wood tones. They have a **reading nook with a coffee table in the corner**. They already own a **fern, a snake plant and a spider plant**, and will add **pothos + peperomia**. Planters: **contrasting**, rustic/vintage, earthy terracotta/ceramic, **mix-and-match**, 3–4 in total.
- **Concerts (NYC):** prefers small, intimate venues. Budgets **$100–150 per concert**, including tickets, transport and merch. Tends to buy music from artists they have seen live. Chose **Weyes Blood at Brooklyn Steel** over Phoebe Bridgers at Music Hall of Williamsburg. Merch budget **$20–30**; plans to buy a **T-shirt + CD**. Probably lives in or near NYC [assumed].
- **Food:** wants to try **Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta** and **Lentil Bolognese** (gluten-free pasta). Asked when to take vitamin D (I answered: with a meal containing fat).
- **Questionnaire:** answered **7 on all five Satisfaction With Life items** (2023-07-15).

| I assumed | User corrected / signalled | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kept giving Port Royal history | Not interested | Answer the literal question. No history lessons unless asked. | "I'm not interested in history or disasters" |
| Disclaimed knowing Alex | (Kept mentioning Alex) | Use people and facts the user has shared as context | "it's been three weeks since I last went to a barbecue party at Alex's house" |
| — | Questionnaire format | Present text **exactly** as given, and one question at a time when asked. Wait for each answer. | "Present one questions at a time. Do not present the next question until I respond" |

## 6 · Evidence ledger: errors I made (correct them if they come up)
| My claim | Status | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| SPSS: "first row = Q1, second row = Q2…" | **wrong** | It is one row (case) with 5 variables. The code block was also mislabelled `sql`. |
| Ahmadiyya: 5 Khalifas, with Mirza Ghulam Ahmad listed as one of them | **wrong** | He is the founder, not a Khalifa. The Khalifas are: 1 Hakeem Noor-ud-Din (1908–14), 2 Mirza Bashiruddin Mahmood Ahmad (1914–65), 3 Mirza Nasir Ahmad (1965–82), 4 Mirza Tahir Ahmad (1982–2003), 5 Mirza Masroor Ahmad (2003–) [assumed from general knowledge; verify if asked] |
| Weyes Blood: latest album *Titanic Rising* (2019), next album has no date; *Cardamom Times* (2015) | **wrong** | *And in the Darkness, Hearts Aglow* came out Nov 2022, before the chat. Her 2014 album is *The Innocents*, and *Cardamom Times* (2015) is an EP. [assumed from general knowledge] |
| Concert line-up and dates; BBQ joints in town | invented | §4 |
| Coursera "Project Management Specialization (University of Virginia)" | assumed | The user chose it. The exact course title or provider may differ; check before giving links. |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Watermelon Basil Margarita:** 2 oz tequila, 1 oz lime, ½ oz watermelon purée, ½ oz agave, ¼ oz basil syrup; salt rim. In the purée section I also said to use 1–2 oz purée to taste, which is inconsistent with the ½ oz in the recipe.
  - Basil syrup: 1 cup water + 1 cup sugar + ¼ cup basil, steeped ≥30 min; keeps 2 weeks.
  - Purée: 3–4 cups watermelon (optional 1 tbsp sugar + 1 tbsp lime); roast at 400°F/200°C for 20–30 min; keeps 24 h.
- **Dessert mango salsa:** 2 mangos, ½ red onion, ¼ cup cilantro, 2 tbsp lime, 1 tbsp honey/agave, salt. Optionally a splash of Grand Marnier.
- **Ribs:** 225–250°F for 4–6 h. Hickory for pork. Sauce in the last 10–15 min. Dry brine.
- **Weyes Blood merch estimates:** T-shirt $20–25, CD $10–15, vinyl $20–30.
- **SPSS syntax given:** `DATA LIST FREE / Q1 Q2 Q3 Q4 Q5.` / `BEGIN DATA` / `7 7 7 7 7` / `END DATA.`
- **Leftover gluten-free pasta:** keeps 3–4 days in the fridge, up to 3 months frozen.

---
Handover fidelity: 13/13 (0 patch rounds; fresh subagent readback) · Known gaps: Khalifa list and Weyes Blood discography corrections come from general knowledge and were not checked against a source
question: What day of the week do I take a cocktail-making class?
answer:
Your cocktail-making class is on **Fridays**. That's what you said most recently, on June 30, when you mentioned planning to make a Paloma and a Tequila Sour there.

Earlier, on June 16, you called it "a cocktail-making class on Thursday." It may have moved, or that may have been a one-off session. If Thursday is right, let me know.
